doc: Reviewer-authority allowlist (order @a1e7b739 C8). Only digests recorded here with status 'reviewed' can yield the gate-bearing N3_PUBLICATION_VERIFIED label. A candidate can never add or promote its own entry: entries are written by order of the auditor, in evidence, outside every code-digest file list (no circular pin). 'pending_review' entries verify as consistent candidates awaiting the reviewer.
